title: In silico study of polyphenols as potential inhibitors of MALT1 protein in non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
authors: Sezer, Abas; Mahmutovic, Lejla; Akcesme, Betul
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接筛选多酚类MALT1蛋白抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) is one of the most common cancer types. Deregulated signaling pathways can trigger certain NHL subtypes, including Diffuse Large B-cell lymphoma. NF-kB signaling pathway, which is responsible for the proliferation, growth, and survival of cells, has an essential role in lymphoma development. Although different signals control NF-kB activation in various lymphoid malignancies, the characteristic one is the CARD11-BCL10-MALT1 (CBM) complex. The CBM complex is responsible for the initiation of adaptive immune response. Our study is focused on the molecular docking of ten polyphenols as potential CARD11-BCL10-MALT1 complex inhibitors, essentially through MALT1 inhibition. Molecular docking was performed by Auto Dock Tools and AutoDock Vina tool, while SwissADME was used for drug-likeness and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) analysis of the ligands. Out of 66 ligands that were used in this study, we selected and visualized five. Selection criteria were based on the binding energy score and position of the ligands on the used protein. 2D and 3D visualizations showed interactions of ligands with the protein. Five ligands are considered potential inhibitors of MALT1, thus affecting NF-kB signaling pathway. However, additional in vivo and in vitro studies are required to confirm their mechanism of inhibition.
abstract_zh: 非霍奇金淋巴瘤（NHL）是最常见的癌症类型之一。信号通路的失调可触发某些NHL亚型，包括弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤。NF-kB信号通路负责细胞的增殖、生长和存活，在淋巴瘤发展中具有重要作用。尽管不同信号控制着多种淋巴恶性肿瘤中的NF-kB激活，但其特征性信号是CARD11-BCL10-MALT1（CBM）复合物。CBM复合物负责适应性免疫反应的启动。我们的研究聚焦于十种多酚类化合物作为潜在CARD11-BCL10-MALT1复合物抑制剂的分子对接，主要通过抑制MALT1实现。分子对接使用Auto Dock Tools和AutoDock Vina工具进行，而SwissADME用于配体的药物相似性和吸收、分布、代谢、排泄及毒性（ADMET）分析。在本研究使用的66个配体中，我们选择并可视化了五个。选择标准基于结合能评分和配体在所使用蛋白质上的位置。二维和三维可视化显示了配体与蛋白质的相互作用。五个配体被认为是MALT1的潜在抑制剂，从而影响NF-kB信号通路。然而，需要进一步的体内和体外研究来确认其抑制机制。
